meta.dataset: pp_sales_pa_a - Property transfers (sales) for Lancaster, York, Dauphin, Cumberland Counties, PA (Broad Sky Partners operating-intelligence portal)
method: Lancaster: ArcGIS REST FeatureServer query on Parcels_HUBnew/FeatureServer/0 (found via Lancaster County LanCo View 2.0 web app config). where=SALE_DATE>=20250901 (SALE_DATE is numeric YYYYMMDD). returnIdsOnly then batched objectIds queries of 500, outFields=*, outSR=4326; polygon area-weighted centroid computed locally. 10,054 records.

York: ArcGIS REST FeatureServer query on arcweb1.ycpc.org OPEN_DATA/Parcels/FeatureServer/0 (York County Planning Commission open data). SALEDT is a DD-MON-YYYY string, so where=SALEDT LIKE '%-SEP-2025' OR ... OR SALEDT LIKE '%-2026'. Same ID-batch pagination, outSR=4326, local centroid. 10,665 records.

Cumberland: ArcGIS REST FeatureServer query on Cumberland County (gis_ccpa) Tax_Parcels/FeatureServer/0, where=SALEDATE >= DATE '2025-09-01' (epoch ms, converted as UTC date). 6,267 polygons -> 6,104 unique PID+date records (multipart duplicates removed).

Dauphin: no public GIS layer carries sale date/price (DC_Parcels, DC_ParcelCharacteristic, Tax_Roll_Table, gis.dauphincounty.org Parcels MapServer, PASDA 2022 parcels checked). Used the county Property Tax Inquiry site (dauphinpa.devnetwedge.com): sale-date search (POST /Search/ExecuteParcelSearch with sale_date_min/max per calendar month) + ExportClientsListToCSV gave 7,810 unique parcels with a recorded sale 2025-09-01..2026-09-24; each parcel page /parcel/view/<key> was then parsed for the Sales History table (document #, sale type, date, sold by, sold to, price) and Structures (year built, gross living area). Centroids from DC_Parcels FeatureServer joined on CAMA_PID (unit parcels fall back to parent lot).
ZIP: Cumberland uses SITUS_ZIP; other counties get ZIP from point-in-polygon of the parcel centroid against 2020 Census ZCTA polygons (TIGERweb PUMA_TAD_TAZ_UGA_ZCTA/MapServer/1).

Municipality: Lancaster DISTRICT (first 2 digits + 0) joined to arcgis.lancastercountypa.gov Muni/MapServer/0; York DISTRICT joined to YCPC OPEN_DATA/Municipal_Boundary (districts 01-15 = York City wards); Cumberland MUNI_NAME; Dauphin Township from parcel page.

builder_flag: regex on seller name (BUILDER(S), DEVELOPER/DEVELOPMENT, HOMES, CONSTRUCTION, COMMUNITIES, NVR, D R HORTON, etc., or LLC/INC/LP combined with development terms such as ESTATES/VILLAGE/MEADOWS/CROSSING/PRESERVE); excludes HUD, redevelopment authorities, community-development nonprofits and 'buys homes' investors. null where seller is unavailable (Lancaster, Cumberland).

arms_length: Dauphin from county sale-type code (0 Valid / Unverified but considered valid / New Construction = true; family/gift, tax/sheriff sale, multiple parcels on deed, questionable, zero value, corrective, government, partial interest = false; blank/Source Cannot be Determined/Demolition = null). Other counties: false when price <= $100 (nominal consideration), otherwise null (no validity code published).

use_type mapping: Lancaster LANDUSECD 101=land (vacant residential lot), other 1xx and 2xx=residential (2xx assumed multi-family/apartment), 4xx=industrial, 5xx(and 3xx)=commercial, 6xx/7xx=other (exempt/institutional/utility), 8xx/9xx=land (agricultural/farm/woodland, may include farmhouse); York CLASS R=residential, C=commercial, I=industrial, F/A=land (farm/agricultural), E/U=other, LUC 100=land; Cumberland P_TYPE R*=residential, C*=commercial, I=industrial, A*/L*/V*=land, else other, LUC 100=land; Dauphin Property Class first letter R/C/I/L(land)/F/A/E.

caveats: Lancaster, York and Cumberland sources are current-parcel snapshots that store only the MOST RECENT sale per parcel: a parcel that sold twice in the window appears once (latest sale), and buyer = current owner of record. Dauphin records come from full per-parcel sales histories, so repeat sales are kept.
Source lag: Lancaster latest sale 2026-08-24, Cumberland 2026-08-27, York 2026-09-16 (roughly 1-5 weeks behind 2026-09-24). Lancaster has no sales on 2025-09-01 (Labor Day).

DAUPHIN IS PARTIAL: the county system lists 7,810 parcels with sales 2025-09-01..2026-09-24, but only 262 parcel pages were retrieved (almost entirely September 2025 transfers) before dauphinpa.devnetwedge.com began returning HTTP 403 Forbidden (pages took ~5-7 s each). Scraping was stopped rather than circumventing the block. Dauphin counts (294 sale rows) are NOT representative of Dauphin volume.
No seller field in Lancaster or Cumberland sources (seller=null, builder_flag=null). York seller = PREV_OWNER (owner before the latest transfer).

Nominal-price transfers ($0/$1, family, estate, trust re-titling) are retained and flagged arms_length=false; filter price > 1000 (and arms_length != false) for market sales. Multi-parcel deeds can repeat one total price across several parcels (visible e.g. in Lancaster/York where the same buyer/date/price appears on adjacent parcels).

ZIP for Lancaster/York/Dauphin is ZCTA-derived from the parcel centroid (approximation of USPS ZIP). lat/lon are parcel polygon centroids (geo_precision=parcel_centroid), rounded to 5 decimals; Dauphin condo/unit parcels without their own polygon use the parent lot centroid.

Use-code meanings for Lancaster LANDUSECD and Dauphin Property Class were inferred from code descriptions/samples; use_code_raw is kept for re-mapping. year_built/sqft/beds only where the source publishes them (York, Cumberland, Dauphin; beds only Cumberland).
Extra fields beyond the base schema: parcel_id, deed_ref (deed book-page or instrument number), and sale_type_raw (Dauphin).
No county exceeded 40,000 records, so no sampling was applied; all qualifying records returned by the sources are included.

QA 2026-09-24: Validated all 27,117 items against schema/date/geo/dedup rules. Removed 7,295 items (26.9%) with price below the $1,000 minimum (nominal/non-arms-length transfers: $0, $1, $5, $7, $10, $100, $500) per QA price rule ( >=1000 or null); these were previously flagged arms_length=false and documented in caveats as intentionally-retained nominal transfers, but fail the strict price>=1000-or-null QA gate and were excluded from this validated dataset. No duplicate ids, no bad dates, no missing state/county/sale_date, no out-of-bounds lat/lon, and no missing addr/lat-lon were found among the remaining 19,822 items. meta.coverage counts updated to match post-QA per-county item counts (Lancaster 7,283; York 7,885; Cumberland 4,427; Dauphin 227). File size 18.97 MB, well under the 30 MB cap, so no size-based trimming was needed. Re-queried the Lancaster County GIS Parcels_HUBnew FeatureServer (services1.arcgis.com/I6XnrlnguPDoEObn) live via PIN 070-2398885-322692-0-0000 (item id PA-LAN-0708859200000-2025-09-02, 522 FOGGY BOTTOM RD): source returned SALE_DATE=20250902, SALE_PRICE=305000, OWNER_NAME=KAUR AMRIT, DEED_BK_PG=20250034334, OWNER_ZIP=17522, exactly matching the item's sale_date, price, buyer, deed_ref and zip.
